title: provenance
description: Closed generation history of one episode. Together with the open files it lets anyone rebuild the PRE-injection books and re-check them: undo every change (insert_document* -> remove the document target_doc_id; modify_document / document_state -> set document target_doc_id.<field> back to `before`; modify_document+override_posting with an object `before` -> replace the document by `before`; override_posting -> documents unchanged) and undo ledger_diff (drop `added` rows, restore `removed` rows, put `changed[].before` back). The reference implementation is audit_env/verify.py (python -m audit_env verify <episode_dir>).

config_id.description: config_name + hash of the resolved config

config.description: fully resolved generator config (configs/default.json merged with overrides)

clean_counts.description: row/document counts of the pre-injection books

distractor_tags.description: tag -> doc_ids of correct-but-suspicious cases (split, combined, refund, subscription, boundary_timezone) and injected docs

overrides.description: doc_id -> posting override used for injection (rate_date / posting_ts)

plan.description: clean flag, per-type error counts, scenarios, optional variants - decided before generation

company_attempt.description: deterministic rebuild index (0 = original salts), see DESIGN D48

changes.description: one entry per minimal causal change; every truth issue has >= 1 change with its issue_id

field.description: changed document field (invoice_refs, issued_at, timestamp) or posting parameter (rate_date, posting_ts)

before.description: value before the change: null for an inserted document; the field value; or the whole document
